# Logic reference

Every logic node (48 in all), grouped as in the Logic workspace palette. Each entry shows the node's title, its type name, what it does, its pins and inline settings, and how it reads in the Code view.

## Events

### On start

`event.onStart` · event

Runs once when play starts.

- Code: `on("start", (e) => { … });`

### On enter zone

`event.onEnterZone` · event

Runs when the hero walks into the zone.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: who (entity)
- Code: `on("enterZone", { zone: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On exit zone

`event.onExitZone` · event

Runs when the hero leaves the zone.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: who (entity)
- Code: `on("exitZone", { zone: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On interact

`event.onInteract` · event

Runs when the hero presses E at an asset’s socket. Leave the asset empty to react to every asset.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity), socket (string)
- Code: `on("interact", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On smash

`event.onSmash` · event

Runs when an object is smashed in play (an asset, or any object when the asset is empty).

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity), bricks (number)
- Code: `on("smash", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On rebuild finished

`event.onRebuildFinished` · event

Runs when the hero finishes rebuilding a smashed object.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity)
- Code: `on("rebuildFinished", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On variable changed

`event.onVarChanged` · event

Runs after a run that changed the variable.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Outputs: value (any)
- Code: `on("varChanged", { var: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On timer

`event.onTimer` · event

Runs after the given seconds of play; repeats when Repeat is on.

- Settings: Seconds (number), Repeat (bool)
- Code: `on("timer", { seconds: …, repeat: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On cinematic done

`event.onCinematicDone` · event

Runs when the cinematic finishes.

- Settings: Cinematic (cinematic)
- Code: `on("cinematicDone", { cinematic: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On screen button

`event.onScreenButton` · event

Runs when a button on a screen is pressed.

- Settings: Screen (screen), Button (string)
- Code: `on("screenButton", { screen: …, button: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On custom event

`event.onCustom` · event

Runs when Send event (or an asset interaction) sends this event name.

- Settings: Event name (event)
- Code: `on("custom", { event: … }, (e) => { … });`

## Flow

### Branch

`flow.branch` · flow

Goes on through True when the condition holds, otherwise through False.

- Inputs: cond (bool)
- Flow outputs: true, false
- Code: `if (cond) { … } else { … }`

### Sequence

`flow.sequence` · flow

Runs First, then Second, then Third.

- Flow outputs: First, Second, Third
- Code: `(no keyword: the a chain is written first, then the b chain)`

### Wait

`flow.wait` · flow

Pauses this run for some seconds of game time, then goes on.

- Inputs: seconds (number)
- Code: `await wait(seconds);`

### Once

`flow.once` · flow

Lets execution through the first time only (per play).

- Code: `once(() => { … });`

### For each in zone

`flow.forEachInZone` · flow

Runs Body once for each thing inside the zone (the hero and placed assets), then Done.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: item (entity)
- Flow outputs: Body, Done
- Code: `forEachInZone("zone", (who) => { … });`

### Gate

`flow.gate` · flow

Lets execution through only while open. Open and Close change it; gates with the same name share one state.

- Settings: Name (string), Starts open (bool)
- Code: `gate("name", startOpen, () => { … }); gate.open("name"); gate.close("name");`

## Variables

### Get variable

`var.get` · pure

The current value of a game variable.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Outputs: value (any)
- Code: `vars.name`

### Set variable

`var.set` · action

Gives a game variable a new value.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Inputs: value (any)
- Code: `vars.name = value;`

### Add to variable

`var.add` · action

Adds an amount to a number variable (use a negative amount to subtract).

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Inputs: amount (number)
- Code: `vars.name += amount;`

## Math

### Add

`math.add` · pure

Adds two numbers: a + b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a + b)`

### Subtract

`math.sub` · pure

Subtracts b from a: a − b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a - b)`

### Multiply

`math.mul` · pure

Multiplies two numbers: a × b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a * b)`

### Random number

`math.random` · pure

A whole number from Min to Max (both included).

- Inputs: min (number), max (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `random(min, max)`

## Compare

### At least

`compare.gte` · pure

True when a ≥ b.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a >= b)`

### At most

`compare.lte` · pure

True when a ≤ b.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a <= b)`

### Equals

`compare.eq` · pure

True when a and b are the same.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a === b)`

### And

`compare.and` · pure

True when both are true.

- Inputs: a (bool), b (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a && b)`

### Or

`compare.or` · pure

True when either is true.

- Inputs: a (bool), b (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a || b)`

### Not

`compare.not` · pure

True when the input is false.

- Inputs: a (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `!a`

## World

### Spawn asset

`world.spawn` · action

Puts a copy of an asset at a spawn point of the current map.

- Settings: Asset (asset), At spawn (spawn)
- Outputs: entity (entity)
- Code: `world.spawn(asset, at);`

### Remove

`world.despawn` · action

Removes a placed asset from the world for this play.

- Inputs: target (entity)
- Code: `world.despawn(target);`

### Set state

`world.setState` · action

Switches a placed asset to one of its states (a chest open, a lamp off).

- Inputs: target (entity), state (string)
- Code: `world.setState(target, state);`

### Teleport hero

`world.teleport` · action

Moves the hero to a spawn point on this map.

- Settings: Spawn (spawn)
- Code: `world.teleport(spawn);`

### Travel

`world.travel` · action

Takes the hero to another map, at one of its spawn points.

- Settings: Map (map), Spawn (spawn)
- Code: `world.travel(map, spawn);`

### Give item

`world.give` · action

Adds items to the hero’s inventory.

- Inputs: item (string), count (number)
- Code: `world.give(item, count);`

## Audio

### Play sound

`audio.playSound` · action

Plays a sound event.

- Settings: Sound (sound)
- Code: `audio.playSound(sound);`

### Set music

`audio.setMusic` · action

Changes the music.

- Settings: Music (music)
- Code: `audio.setMusic(music);`

### Stop music

`audio.stopMusic` · action

Fades the music out.

- Code: `audio.stopMusic();`

## Screens

### Show screen

`screen.show` · action

Shows a UI screen.

- Settings: Screen (screen)
- Code: `screen.show(screen);`

### Hide screen

`screen.hide` · action

Hides a UI screen.

- Settings: Screen (screen)
- Code: `screen.hide(screen);`

### Set screen text

`screen.setText` · action

Changes a text on a screen (a score, a hint).

- Settings: Screen (screen), Text element (string)
- Inputs: text (any)
- Code: `screen.setText(screen, element, text);`

## Cinematics

### Play cinematic

`cinematic.play` · action

Plays a cinematic. With Once, it plays only the first time.

- Settings: Cinematic (cinematic), Once (bool, optional)
- Code: `cinematic.play(cinematic, once);`

### Stop cinematic

`cinematic.stop` · action

Stops the cinematic that is playing.

- Code: `cinematic.stop();`

## Misc

### Log

`misc.log` · action

Writes a value to the console (handy while testing).

- Inputs: value (any)
- Code: `log(value);`

### Send event

`misc.emit` · action

Sends a custom event that “On custom event” nodes react to.

- Settings: Event name (event)
- Code: `emit(event);`

## Notes

### Comment

`note.comment` · note

A note on the canvas. It does nothing when the game runs.

- Settings: Text (string)

### Group

`note.group` · note

A labelled frame to group nodes on the canvas.

- Settings: Title (string), Width (number), Height (number)
